Achievement unlockedHulk Smash, Again

A small release with four fixes. Hulk's Crushing Blow can be played again when your hand holds other resources beside a [physical] one, thanks to @dalamillo's report. And @bluefireF5ran replayed real games from their saves and found three rules bugs: an extra side scheme in each Wrecking Crew deck, encounter cards that hit an alter-ego's hero, and a stage of Ultron's main scheme that answered the threat that revealed it.

Crushing Blow lands again

Issue #648 by @dalamillo · PR #649

Crushing Blow says you can only spend [physical] resources to pay for it. The game read that as "your whole hand has to be [physical]", so with any other card in hand it showed Crushing Blow as unaffordable. Now it's offered whenever a [physical] card or a wild resource can pay for it, and the payment takes only the resources the card accepts.

What changed

  • A card that only takes some resource types is checked against only the resources it can take.
  • The payment sheet suggests paying with the [physical] card, and leaves the rest of your hand alone.
  • With no [physical] card or wild resource to spend, Crushing Blow still can't be played.

Found by replaying real games

PRs #644, #645 and #646 by @bluefireF5ran

@bluefireF5ran loaded real games from their saves and watched for anything the cards don't allow. Each of these three bugs showed up in a game someone actually played.

Breakout · The Wrecking Crew

One side scheme each

Each villain's encounter deck held a second copy of his signature side scheme, which already starts in play. Each deck now has 15 cards, so there is no more second Pile It On! or Thunderstruck.

The Wrecking Crew insert, pp. 3 and 4
Core Set encounter cards

"Your hero" means a hero

Sweeping Swoop no longer stuns an alter-ego. Under Attack and Electric Whip Attack no longer offer to damage your hero while you're in alter-ego form.

RRG 1.8 "Form, Change Form", p. 21
Ultron

NORAD waits its turn

When step one's threat completes The Crimson Cowl, Assault on NORAD no longer answers that same threat by asking each player for 2 threat or a Drone.

RRG 1.8 "Main Scheme", p. 27 · FAQ p. 62
